blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P214.44 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot was not won on the Sept. 21. This was according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). This means that bettors will still have a chance to win the P200 million plus jackpot, which is expected to increase in the next Grand Lotto draw on Wednesday, Sept. 23. Aside from this, no bettor also won the Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot of P67.37 million on the draw on Monday, Sept. 21.
